name: favi
description: Favi, the design buddy from Idea Forge, living on your god-mode rail. Chat with a Favi who can actually see your game and answers with tap-to-send follow-ups. NEW: Playtest Eyes, she watches you play for a minute and tells you where you got stuck, bored or lost. Plan vs game shows how much of your Forge file is really built. A daily spark idea on her home screen, and your style moodboard on top of chat. Carry your Idea Forge files in pocket form: edit fields, answer her question rounds, then Finalize into prompts, a rating, a pitch card or a one-tap Savi build brief. Name an art style and she gathers 10+ reference images; tap one to get more like it, then type /style to Savi. Plus a ranked Mod Market, /mods, /favi and /uninstall.
